chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Adam, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Khazzaz, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Ala', from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him).

He said: I heard him say: The most beloved of worshipers to God, Mighty and Majestic, is a man who is truthful in his speech, who maintains his prayers and what God has obligated upon him, along with fulfilling trusts.

Then he (peace be upon him) said: Whoever is entrusted with a trust and fulfills it has unfastened a thousand knots from his neck — knots of the Fire. So hasten to fulfill trusts, for when one is entrusted with a trust, Iblis assigns one hundred devils from his rebellious helpers to misguide him and whisper to him until they destroy him — except for one whom God, Mighty and Majestic, protects.

key_terms.أمانة: Amanah — trust, something entrusted to one's care; includes material and moral responsibilities
key_terms.صدوق: Saduq — extremely truthful, one who habitually speaks the truth
key_terms.عقدة: Uqdah — knot or collar; here metaphorical for bonds/shackles of punishment in Hellfire
key_terms.مردة: Maradah — the most rebellious and wicked ones; refers to the most powerful demons among Iblis's forces

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Sadiq say about the virtue of fulfilling trusts in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the most beloved servant of God as one who combines three qualities: truthfulness in speech, constancy in prayer and religious obligations, and trustworthiness. He then elaborates on the immense spiritual reward of fulfilling trusts — releasing a thousand knots of Hellfire from one's neck — while warning that Iblis deploys a hundred demons to tempt those entrusted with responsibilities. This teaching was delivered in the context of the early Shia community where trust and honesty in social dealings were considered essential markers of piety.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Yahya b. `Imran al-Ash`ari from Muhammad b. Adam from al-Hasan b. `Ali al-Khazar from al-Husayn b. Abi’l `Ala’ from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as).
He said: I heard him say: The most beloved of worshipers to Allah is a man who is truthful in his speech, maintaining his prayers and what Allah has obligated him with, and fulfilling trusts.

Then, he (as) said: Whoever is entrusted with a trust and fulfills it will be unfastened from one thousand collars of fire. So, hasten to fulfilling trusts, for when one is entrusted with a trust, Iblis assigns one hundred devils from his demons to misguide him and whisper to him to diminish him – except for one whom Allah protects.
